run_distributed_training: run distributed training for diplomacy agents using SLURM with srun and ParlAI arguments
run_distributed_training_with_model: run distributed training with a specific model like seq2seq on the convai2 dataset via SLURM
register_diplomacy_agents: register all diplomacy-specific agents into the ParlAI agent registry using load.register_all_agents
register_diplomacy_tasks: register all diplomacy-specific tasks into the ParlAI task registry using load.register_all_tasks
run_distributed_training_with_dict: run distributed training with a custom dictionary file path passed via the dict-file argument
